# 6_coverage_report

Proof that nothing in the source documents was skipped: one report per document cut into pieces (`<document>.md`). It shows that every line of the law is in exactly one piece (or is page furniture: the repeated page title, running header and download footer), and lists each piece with its label and whether an architect approved it.

**Generated by code only** (`python -m section_labeling coverage`). **Never hand-edit.** CI re-makes it on every change and fails if it differs, or if any line is in no piece or in two.
